guides.playerProblem: Complete a seven-prompt Daily Dive without losing valid answers to category drift, late submission, or rejection recovery.
verifiedMechanics: Seven open-answer prompts per Daily Dive
A 25-second decision window on each live prompt
A running timer can permit a replacement after a not-on-this-answer-list response
Six fixed score tiers and a final score-to-depth conversion

observedSequence: Google Ads and falcon as early valid but ordinary choices

Post-run alternatives reviewed after all seven prompts

guides.playerProblem: Distinguish launcher, host, focus, mobile layout, validation, and network failures without refreshing a recoverable run.
verifiedMechanics: The site does not create a game iframe before Play Now
The loaded title screen and Begin Descent control belong to the external game
Visible text in the answer field proves keyboard and focus input reached the game
A validator rejection is different from a frozen or unavailable player

guides.playerProblem: Use fixed tier values and category confidence to improve total depth without turning uncommon recall into invalid guesses.
verifiedMechanics: Depth in metres equals total score multiplied by ten
Seven maximum answers total 700 points and 7,000 m
Rarity feedback describes the response result, while validity remains a separate gate
